verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents its own programmatic surfaces for tenant management. The official MCP server lets agents create apps, deploy Actions, debug logs and manage users 'without touching the dashboard'. The Auth0 CLI manages tenant configuration, and a Terraform module sets up apps, APIs, roles, MFA, SSO and custom domains. None of these claims full UI parity, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicit claim that the API covers every UI action, a discoverable OpenAPI spec or Management API reference in the evidence, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
